scripts.generate: cargo run -p backend -- --openapi > openapi.json && openapi-gen-ts openapi.json frontend/src/api
scripts.dev: cargo watch -w backend/ -w frontend/ -- cargo run
scripts.test: cargo test && pnpm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.lint: cargo clippy -- -D warnings && pnpm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: cargo fmt && pnpm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --check && pnpm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm --prefix frontend run check
